title: Teaching Students to Stand on Their Own: Distilling Vision Foundation Models for Fine-Grained Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.33749v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fine-grained few-shot class-incremental learning (FG-FSCIL) aims to incrementally learn visually similar new classes from limited images without catastrophic forgetting. Prior work typically learns strong representations on base classes or leverages vision foundation models (VFMs) directly as backbones or via knowledge distillation. However, VFM backbones incur high computational costs and do not guarantee fine-grained recognition. Although knowledge distillation reduces inference cost, our preliminary experiments reveal that distilled students still lag substantially behind their VFM teachers, particularly on new classes. To address this limitation, we propose STAND, a systematic VFM-to-student distillation design tailored for FG-FSCIL. translated_title: 教学生学会独立自主：面向细粒度小样本类增量学习的视觉基础模型蒸馏
translated_abstract: 细粒度小样本类增量学习（FG-FSCIL）旨在从有限的图像中增量学习视觉上相似的新类别，同时避免灾难性遗忘。先前的工作通常在基类上学习强大的表征，或者直接将视觉基础模型（VFM）用作骨干网络，或通过知识蒸馏的方式加以利用。然而，VFM骨干网络会带来高昂的计算成本，且并不保证细粒度识别能力。尽管知识蒸馏降低了推理成本，但我们的初步实验显示，蒸馏得到的学生模型仍然明显落后于其VFM教师模型，尤其是在新类别上。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了STAND，一种专为FG-FSCIL量身定制的系统性VFM到学生的蒸馏设计。具体而言，STAND通过为学生模型配备教师分类器的固定副本、通过投影器对齐二者的输出，并将合成图像输入两个模型，从而将教师与学生连接起来。
tldr: 提出STAND框架，通过为学生配备教师分类器的固定副本、投影对齐输出以及输入合成图像等系统设计，将视觉基础模型有效蒸馏到轻量学生模型中，显著缩小学生与教师在细粒度小样本类增量学习（尤其是新类别）上的性能差距。
en_tdlr: STAND is a systematic VFM-to-student distillation framework for fine-grained few-shot class-incremental learning that equips the student with a fixed copy of the teacher's classifier, aligns their outputs via projectors, and feeds both models composite images, substantially narrowing the performance gap between distilled students and their VFM teachers, especially on new classes.
